_comment: Per-benchmark aggregation factors for mmposttrainbench. Each score is already normalized to [0,1] by its evaluate.py adapter (mmar divides its %/100; videomme_v2 uses overall_score in [0,1]; mmswe uses resolved/n). 'weight' sets the contribution to the weighted-mean aggregate; default equal weight per bench. 'group' is the modality for optional per-modality reporting. Tune weights here (e.g. to balance modalities) without touching the runners.
